chunks: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Abi Abdullah, from his father, from Al-Muttalib ibn Ziyad, from Abu Bakr ibn Abdullah Al-Ash'ari, who said:
I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about the musk, 'Is it permissible to smell it?' So he (peace be upon him) said: 'We do smell it'.

key_terms.أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ: Abu Abdullah, a title for Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq (peace be upon him)

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to smell musk in Islam?
ai.summary: This concise narration from al-Kafi highlights the Imam’s practical endorsement of musk, affirming its ritual purity (taharah) and permissibility for sensory enjoyment. By stating 'we smell it,' Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) provides a normative precedent that counters any restrictive views, emphasizing the material's suitability for both personal adornment and general use in Shia jurisprudence.
